mechanism_narrative: An increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX 60-day returns are negative more than 40% of the time, this hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 50-day moving average signals increased supply and productivity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises above 105 but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 35% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When both unemployment (UNRATE) decreases and employment (PAYEMS) increases, it signals a strong labor market, which should boost consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both UNRATE and PAYEMS improve but SPX 20-day returns are not positive in at least 60% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% indicates tighter monetary policy, which may reduce borrowing and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% but SPX 20-day returns remain positive in more than 30% of cases, the hypothesis is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real estate investment (RSAFS) reflects strong demand in the housing market, which should positively impact related sectors and lead to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but SPX 5-day returns are negative more than 45% of the time, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% indicates a strong labor market, which should support consumer spending and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE stays below 4% but SPX 60-day returns are not positive in at least 55% of cases, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) accelerates and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains stable, it indicates balanced economic growth, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows and CPIAUCSL remains stable but SPX 60-day returns are not positive in at least 50% of cases, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) increase, it signals strong economic activity, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If both INDPRO and HOUST increase but SPX 20-day returns are not positive in at least 60% of cases, the hypothesis fails.
